dynamicAttributes.help: Number of transcript models identified for the gene
dynamicAttributes.name: num_new_models

dynamicAttributes.htmlHelp:
Describes how the TALON prediction differs from the gene model
Intergenic:
Intergenic predictions lack any overlap with known genes
Novel In Collection (NIC):
Prediction uses known splice donors and acceptors but reveals new connections (e.g., skipped exon isoforms)
Novel Not in Collection (NNC):
Prediction has at least one novel donor or acceptor (i.e., at least one novel exon boundary)
Incomplete Splice Match (ISM):
Prediction matches subsection of a known transcript model but has a novel putative start or end point
Genomic:
Prediction has no overlapping splice junctions compared to known transcripts
Known:
Prediction exactly matches a known model
Antisense:
Prediction overlaps an existing model but is oriented in the opposite direction
dynamicAttributes.name: transcript_novelty

dynamicAttributes.htmlHelp:
Subcategory for ISM predictions
Suffix:
Mismatch at 5' end
Prefix:
Mismatch at 3' end
Both:
Mismatches at both ends
None:
Category for other transcript novelty types
dynamicAttributes.name: incomplete_splice_match_type

dynamicAttributes.name: median_raw_hits

dynamicAttributes.name: median_haploid_hits

dynamicAttributes.help: The number of genes in the reference annotation inferred to have arisen through the tandem duplication of a common ancestor of this gene.  This is estimated as the number of genes that are both on the same chromosome and in the same ortholog group as the gene of interest.
dynamicAttributes.name: ref_cn

dynamicAttributes.help: An estimate of the number of copies of the chromosome that this gene is on calculated by the analysis pipeline. Median is calculated across strains/samples meeting the search criteria.
dynamicAttributes.name: median_ploidy_hits

dynamicAttributes.help: An estimate of the total number of copies of the gene of interest, accounting for the ploidy of the chromosome. Median is calculated across strains/samples meeting the search criteria.
dynamicAttributes.name: median_gene_dose_hits

dynamicAttributes.help: The median number of copies of this gene across all selected strains/samples as calculated by the analysis pipeline.  This metric is appropriate to use in a non-clonal population.
dynamicAttributes.name: median_raw_all

dynamicAttributes.help: An estimate of the number of copies of this gene on a single copy of the chromosome.  Median is calculated across all selected strains/samples.
dynamicAttributes.name: median_haploid_all

dynamicAttributes.help: An estimate of the total number of copies of the chromosome that this gene is on calculated by the analysis pipeline. Median is calculated across all selected strains/samples.
dynamicAttributes.name: median_ploidy_all

dynamicAttributes.help: An estimate of the total number of copies of the genes of interest, accounting for the ploidy of the chromosome.  Median is calculated across all selected strains/samples.
dynamicAttributes.name: median_gene_dose_all
